Digital Twin for Asset Integrity in Mesaieed — NDT Data on a Live 3D Model

Atlantis NDT Digital Twin gives integrity teams in Mesaieed, Qatar one 3D model of the asset with every UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and ET reading mapped to the exact location it was taken. Corrosion rates trend automatically, API 581 RBI scores update as data lands, and API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 Level 1 and Level 2 assessments run against measured thickness instead of a spreadsheet snapshot.

The Mesaieed asset base this is built for

Mesaieed Industrial City is Qatar's primary petrochemical and heavy-industry hub south of Doha, home to QatarEnergy's Mesaieed Refinery, Qatar Petrochemical Company (QAPCO), Qatar Fuel Additives Company (QAFAC), the ORYX GTL gas-to-liquids plant, and Qatar Steel's electric arc furnace operations, all clustered along a dense industrial coastline with dedicated port facilities. The mix of refining, olefins/polyethylene petrochemical production, methanol/MTBE synthesis, and gas-to-liquids conversion means Mesaieed's inspection landscape spans high-temperature cracking furnaces, cryogenic and pressurized storage, and reactive-service piping systems, all requiring coordinated API 510/570/653 and RBI programs under Qatar's Ministry of Environment and Climate Change industrial safety oversight. QatarEnergy's broader digitalization push across its downstream portfolio makes Mesaieed a natural candidate for 3D digital twins that unify inspection data across the multiple co-located but separately operated plants sharing utilities and pipe racks.

How the twin is built

Capture the geometry (LiDAR, photogrammetry, drone survey, or import your existing BIM/CAD and isometrics), ingest inspection data over REST API or file drop from any instrument, overlay the governing damage mechanisms per API RP 571, then publish colour-coded remaining-life and RBI views to integrity, maintenance and planning. Records are retained audit-ready under ISO 9001, ISO 17020 and ISO 17025.

Integrations

SAP PM, Oracle eAM, IBM Maximo, ServiceNow, AVEVA PI, OSIsoft historians, Bentley iTwin, Cognite and Atlantis NDT ERP. Full REST API and bulk data export — you keep your data in a format you can leave with.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Atlantis Digital Twin work in Mesaieed?

We start with a 3D scan of your asset (drone, laser, photogrammetry), build a CAD-fidelity model, and then overlay every NDT inspection event (UT thickness readings, TOFD/PAUT scans, MT/PT indications, RT defect maps). Inspection data updates the model in real-time and colour-codes condition zones for engineering review. Operators in Mesaieed use this to drive faster turnaround scoping, automated FFS evidence, and audit-grade regulatory reporting.

What does Digital Twin NDT cost in Mesaieed?

Atlantis Digital Twin is an affordable, accessible, fully customizable enterprise SaaS platform sized for up to 500 assets, with ASNT Level III consulting and unlimited NDT data ingest included. Enterprise tiers are available for multi-site fleets, and on-prem deployment is offered at the same price point. Request a Mesaieed-specific quote and we will model your asset count and data-volume requirements.

How long does deployment take in Mesaieed?

A typical first-asset deployment runs 8-12 weeks: 2 weeks model build, 2 weeks data integration, 2-4 weeks workflow configuration, 2 weeks user training. Multi-asset rollouts are sequenced asset-by-asset after the first deployment is live, with each subsequent asset typically taking 4-6 weeks once the platform is configured for your Mesaieed site.

Which NDT standards does the platform support in Mesaieed?

API 510 (pressure vessels), API 570 (piping), API 653 (storage tanks), API 579 FFS, API 581 RBI, ASME Section V articles 2/4/6/7, ISO 9712 personnel qualification, ASNT SNT-TC-1A, and local code requirements depending on Mesaieed's regulatory environment. Custom reporting templates can be configured for any additional national or operator-specific code.

Can Atlantis Digital Twin integrate with our existing CMMS in Mesaieed?

Yes. We support REST API hooks for IBM Maximo, SAP PM, IFS, Oracle EAM, and most major CMMS platforms. Work-order creation, asset master sync, anomaly hand-off into corrective work, and FFS evidence packaging for management-of-change submittals can all be automated, allowing your Mesaieed integrity team to focus on engineering judgement rather than data entry.
